description: Presidential Secretariat - Mr. D. M. J. Dissanayake appointed as an Assistant Director to the Presidents Staff w.e.f. 01.11.2018
categorisation: This gazette content solely announces the appointment of a specific individual (Mr. D. M. J. Dissanayake) to a government position (Assistant Director to the President’s staff). This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
